material_updates.impact: The next screen must use the existing async-wave path with conservative layer31 capacity recovery only, not a new core, metadata-staging, stream-only, scratch-empty, or native-kernel branch.

material_updates.action: Bound the candidate stack to opt013 plus async wave batch access and layer31 capacity recovery.
material_updates.finding: opt021 showed layer31 0.875 and 0.9375 were memory-saving and correctness-clean without async wave but each missed one throughput axis; opt024 showed async-wave can recover throughput on opt013 capacity and an aggressive lower-memory stack, but the aggressive two-round confirmation regressed e2e.
material_updates.impact: Screen exactly one C1 round at layer31=0.875 with RETROINFER_ASYNC_WAVE_BATCH_ACCESS=1; if and only if C1 is execution/correctness-clean and misses throughput retention, screen exactly one C2 round with layer31=0.9375. Promote only a qualifying one-round candidate to exact two-round confirmation.

decision_impact: Proceed with a no-source, env-gated conservative async-wave capacity screen on the canonical 120000x8/cache_ratio=0.05/gen_len=100 harness.
